reason: Decision (a) W3: one name per interface-slot wrapper in every module (rule R1: the TITLE symbol, else ENG1, else ENG3; slot 0x94 keeps _random_limit). Each accepted wrapper definition keeps its complete contribution under the family name; each accepted caller keeps identical records under the new keys (same kind, rva, size, evidence and uses). Families come from slot-normalized original bytes (wrapper_twins.py); names are never identity.
